horoscope: You're more focused on your goals and objectives today, dear Aries, and meeting your responsibilities without delay can help shield you from emotional ups and downs. You're at your best taking care of business today. Perhaps you're pushing yourself a little harder now, and while this can get you places, overdoing may be a problem--once you achieve something, you may have your eye on the next level before taking time to enjoy your accomplishments. Aim to get in touch with the need for some degree of independence and freedom. Fortunately, good conversations or thinking sessions can be enjoyed that help further your goals. From time to time these days, you can feel rather weighed down by responsibilities and restrictions and might be questioning the amount of time and effort you have been putting into certain projects or towards your goals. You may feel that there has been little in the way of freedom to pursue your more creative interests. Aim to cut out distractions as much as possible.

Today's Moon cooperates with your sign, dear Taurus, and it encourages looking forward to new plans and projects rather than worrying too much about the intricacies of the present. Still, there could be a broken agreement or canceled social engagement to manage. Some areas today can prove to be a little challenging, with mixed feelings or drives to manage. You may be seeking a higher level of freedom and well-being, and communications today are likely to be rewarding and inspiring as the day advances. You more easily find ways to express your feelings or channel your energy into satisfying activities. Sharing your ideas and dreams can give you or a relationship a boost.

The tendency to see-saw between intensive inquiry and detached acceptance can bewilder people around you today, dear Gemini. You may want to keep an eye on it, especially since it doesn't do you any favors right now. You have a low tolerance threshold when it comes to waste and inefficiency today, making it important to recognize priorities and then zero in on perfecting and developing what truly matters to you right now. There can be some tension or resistance to manage before you come into your own today, but if you move slowly and steadily, you're more likely to reach your goals in ways that make you proud. Try to balance your time well. Later today, communications tend to be friendly, fair, and also quite helpful. Good energy supports you in developing a relationship, making a significant lifestyle change, and researching and developing a project.

The Moon spends the day in your partnership sector, dear Cancer, and you seek more balance in your life. Current transits may remind you of a long-term matter related to career, performance, and others' expectations of you. You are aware that you need to make changes, but you could be struggling with a desire to keep things as they are or were. It's difficult to embrace change when there are unknowns or larger responsibilities involved, but the alternative is stagnation, which simply won't do. The goal to heal and move beyond problems comes into place, but you may want to spend extra time feeling the problems and understanding them or learning from them. As the day advances, you may find that opening up can help improve your mindset. Fortunately, there can be satisfying conversations and good ideas, especially about creative or entertainment interests.

The Moon spends all day in your work and health sector, dear Leo, and your attention is on the important systems and routines that keep your life running smoothly and yourself healthy and balanced. Today, you may have good conversations or ideas about how to improve these things. Still, you may be reminded of disagreements about beliefs and opinions that are an ongoing source of frustration. Part of you could be feeling worried that people in your life are changing, and you may be sentimental about keeping things as they were. Problems of this kind are difficult to resolve all at once, as a process is involved, and it's about learning to let change happen, even as it involves some unknowns. As the day advances, you can enjoy discovering or rediscovering ideas, projects, or even a person you love.

The Moon spends the day in your entertainment sector, dear Virgo, and you're feeling the need for emotional refreshment. You might come to a better understanding or new insight that moves a relationship or project to a whole new level. Still, aim to recognize when it serves your best interests to let go of something that's consuming too much of your time and bringing you down. Look for reasons to take a healthy escape from serious business, unless, of course, serious business is your particular pleasure at the moment! Whether or not to make changes or to stick with traditional or familiar patterns can be an issue today. You'll find a healthy balance, although you may agonize over the details a little before you get there. While there's some tendency to worry or stew if you're in limbo on a matter, the day shapes up to help open communications.

Sticking to what's familiar today holds special appeal, dear Libra, with the Moon in your solar fourth house all day. In fact, it can be helpful and healing at this time of the lunar month. The desire to improve your personal life or domestic world may be building. You can come to interesting ideas and conclusions about your need for security, nurturance, and familiarity. Still, there can be differences in opinion or inner "disputes" today that lead to some feeling of disorganization. You aspire to feeling contentment with people exactly as they are today, but another side of you has difficulty letting go of certain issues or trains of thought, which can lead to a bit of unrest. Look for ways to let go of unnecessary worry and guilt. Fortunately, as the day advances, you find it easier than usual to bond with others through shared or similar beliefs. You might enjoy new ways of thinking or different perspectives.

The Moon is in your communications sector all day, dear Scorpio, and you're putting your feelers out for great ideas and potential interests. Conversations and thoughts, especially later today, can be particularly useful. You're likely to crave company and cooperation. Still, areas of imbalance in your life can be more evident at times today, and you're quick to correct them. You may feel some frustration with work or routines, or struggle to move past an old frustration. You might get over this hump more easily if you take things slowly. Doing one thing well, instead of many things satisfactorily, is most rewarding at the moment, and this approach suits you particularly well. You are more impressed by others' respect and honesty than praise or niceties, and this quality is emphasized today.

Your feelings tend to settle in today, dear Sagittarius, and you seek some form of emotional balance. Physical pleasures and comfort are especially appealing and appropriate right now. It's a good time to see what needs improving and assess areas of waste in your life, as you are a little more strict in your outlook than usual. Still, it can be a little too easy to be quite preoccupied with personal matters. Part of you wants to pull yourself out of a certain train of thought and would prefer to let go of the past and move on. Consider which attitude serves your best interests the most right now, and choose it instead of swinging back and forth between the two. You'll probably do better for yourself in the long run if you can handle the practical things so that you can put them behind you. Later today, you're likely to find particularly interesting things to do and learn, and pacing yourself comes more naturally.

The Moon spends the whole day in your sign, dear Capricorn, and this brings a stronger need for your feelings to be acknowledged. There is good energy for back-and-forth with colleagues and acquaintances. You are able to get your message across. However, frustrations with home or personal matters seem to be ongoing with you from time to time, and decisions can be difficult to come by on these fronts. Attempts to move forward seem to be thwarted in little, irritating ways, but you are especially resilient, bouncing back quickly. Simplifying makes the most sense, and you might come to a better understanding of someone, which helps you feel more productive as it frees your mind.

The Moon spends today in your privacy sector, dear Aquarius, and if you can spend some time free from interference so that you can do your own thing, you can benefit greatly from the process. However, you may not entirely escape distractions, as others may seek you out for answers or commitments you don't feel ready to give right now. You are a certainly an individualist, and you prefer to make your own rules, and the wisdom in this is appreciated these days. However, people around you may be micromanaging, which can be frustrating. Do your best to handle this gracefully and honor your need to improvise. While you are unlikely to resolve this problem now, you may get important clues about your next step. Fortunately, today is good for communicating, and you enjoy feeling understood. Sharing ideas or activities might enhance or create a bond. While there can be some clashes between your need to wind down and your duties, it's best to honor your need to take a pause and center yourself.

With today's Moon, you're in need of a change of atmosphere, dear Pisces. You're likely to seek out accepting, easygoing environments and people now. Difficulties on the home front or with finances can resurface, however, and increasing responsibilities make it difficult to handle current problems. In some areas today, you can feel stunted in terms of growth and progress. However, fear of change can also be at play. Resolution to these ongoing challenges is unlikely to come right away, but you could get some important clues, so be alert to signals. Fortunately, good energy is with you for communicating your wishes, even with some bumps or obstacles. You may very well bring others together with your advice.
